question: How can a teacher reset a student password in Clever?
answer:
## How a Teacher Can Reset a Student Password in Clever

This feature is only available **if your school district has enabled it**. Here are the steps:

1. Log in to your **Teacher Portal**
2. Click on **My Students** in the left-side menu
3. Choose **Student Roster**
4. Filter by class if needed, then click on the specific student from the roster
5. On the right side of the Portal, under the student's name, find **Student Tools**
6. Click **Set new password**

That's it! Depending on your district's settings, this will reset the student's password for any login method managed by Clever (e.g., it may reset both Google and Clever passwords simultaneously).

> ⚠️ **Important notes:**
> - If you don't see the **Set new password** option, your district has **not enabled** this feature. In that case, contact your school's tech support for help.
> - Students may also be able to reset their own passwords if the school has enabled that option.

**Source:** [For Teachers: How to reset passwords for yourself and students](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001612?language=en_US)
